# Source-only public binary-tree requests

These 1,197 frozen requests preserve every one of the 886 Lazy-era source/request
pairs and add 245 ordinary tree sources, 49 default level boundaries and 17
explicit controls. The 145,529,306 source bytes are regenerated deterministically.
Before execution the policy predicts 1,099 admitted, 49 resource and 49 unsupported
outcomes. These classifications and 44 complete-frame equivalence groups are
hypotheses, not successful codec observations.

All 311 new request tuples and all newly admitted historical tuples are resolved
independently from the pinned original C preset table. `resolved_tuples` retains
historical identities for predecessor requests. Public C does not report an
applied tuple; independently reconstructed values must not be called C observations.
See `docs/reference-tree-interop-protocol.md` and reproduce with
`scripts/check_tree_interop_recipes.py --check`, without child execution.
